title: Add local update and rollback drill view
purpose: Expose A/B rootfs update and rollback evidence as an operator-facing production readiness view.
scope: Render active slot, pending slot and rollback slot evidence when available.
Render update metadata signature and health-check state from release artifacts.
Render rollback drill status and previous active set preservation.
Show update operations as evidence and preview, not direct host mutation.
Link failures to promotion blocker panel.
acceptance_criteria: Update view shows active/pending/rollback evidence when present.
Failed health or rollback drill is visible as blocker.
TUI does not perform update or rollback side effects directly.
Rollback evidence remains tied to audit/release artifacts.
failure_modes: Failed rollback drill is hidden behind promotable status.
Unsigned metadata is rendered as acceptable.
